description: A gilded galley with a purple canopy and gold-carved hull sits on dark water, oars extended. Several women in white and gold robes attend a reclining woman in the stern under the canopy. On the right bank, armoured soldiers with spears and round shields, one in a red cloak and crested helmet, stand near a classical temple on a hill. Painterly oil style, warm late-afternoon light, no visible text or frame.
